deviations.violated_invariant: Product code, solve API and checkpoint identity remain unchanged until locked validation passes.
deviations.deviation: The commits added and validated a prepared_coloring keyword on GeoTargetCore.solve_local. solve_local is exported by GeoTargetCore, and the ProblemSpec overload forwards arbitrary keyword arguments, so this changed the product/public callable surface before locked validation.
unchanged_but_insufficient: The default _CompiledAttemptRunner remained on dense finite differences.
Checkpoint identity and wire schemas remained unchanged.
deviations.historical_audit: Commit d7ad9ba added the earlier jacobian_entries experimental seam before EXP-JAC-001, whose card did not contain the JAC002 product-unchanged invariant. That precedent cannot narrow the later explicit EXP-JAC-002 invariant, and no preregistered amendment or ADR did so.
deviations.discovery_point: Discovered by static card-to-code audit during the exclusive formal development rerun, after J0 had been staged and J1 had started, before staging verification, official publication, or formal outcome inspection.
deviations.decision: Terminate EXP-JAC-002 as nonpromotable. Do not interpret it as a formal algorithm rejection or promotion, do not open locked inputs, and do not merge its prepared_coloring product commits.
deviations.remediation: Remove prepared_coloring from product code, move any future cached-coloring mechanism behind a research-only seam, and preregister a new experiment with new development generators and seeds before measuring it.
